successors.name: Qin (state)
successors.text: the Chengdu Plain, annexed by Qin in 316 and made a commandery (Shu jun)

ledger.x: 1046 BC: Shu is on record as an ally of King Wu of Zhou at Muye.
666 BC: the Kaiming dynasty takes the throne.
316 BC: the Kaiming kingdom of Shu ends in Qin conquest.

wars.name: Qin conquest of Shu and Ba
wars.outcome: Qin victory: Shu annexed as a commandery in 316; Ba taken the same year (see the ba dossier).

wars.name: Shu-Qin clash near Hanzhong
wars.outcome: A clash only: 'in 387 Shu and Qin troops clashed near Hanzhong on the upper Han river'; the page gives no result and no change of border.

certainty.note: No boundary is documented for Shu; the extent is the Chengdu Plain from the archaeology and the page's one-line 'extension northeast to the upper Han'.
